entities.name: Eugène Gabritschevsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Gabritschevsky was a Russian biologist and artist. He was born into a comfortable family of scientists from Imperial Russia. His father was a bacteriologist, and worked with Louis Pasteur in France and with Robert Koch in Germany.
